title: Information Limits of Replay-Free Recurrent State Migration
abstract: arXiv:2611.19345v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a recurrent model is replaced, its old state may not determine what the new model would compute from the same history. We characterize the information that must be retained before the replacement is known. For a time-invariant affine linear family, the minimum continuous causal memory for order-$k$ local migration equals the reachable dimension of a lifted coefficient system minus the information in the anchor state. A controllable $d$-state model with scalar input needs at most $kd$ additional real coordinates, even when arbitrary matrix replacement directions are revealed only after streaming. A single rank-one direction can already require all $kd$. Conditional singular values and auxiliary-bit bounds distinguish this local information law from recovery at a fixed tolerance. translated_title: 免重放循环状态迁移的信息极限
translated_abstract: 当一个循环（递归）模型被替换时，其旧状态可能无法决定新模型基于相同历史输入会计算出什么。本文刻画了在替换方案未知之前必须保留的信息。对于时不变的仿射线性模型族，阶数为k的局部迁移所需的最小连续因果记忆，等于提升系数系统的可达维数减去锚定状态所含的信息。对于带标量输入的可控d状态模型，即使任意的矩阵替换方向仅在流式处理之后才被揭示，也至多需要kd个额外的实数坐标；而单个秩一方向就可能已经要求全部kd个坐标。条件奇异值与辅助比特界将该局部信息定律与固定容差下的恢复区分开来。作者还给出了不变子空间与未来输出相关的构造，并通过受控实验比较了由此产生的各种状态表示。在一个小型语言模型中……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文刻画了循环模型在不重放历史数据的条件下进行状态迁移所必须保留的最小信息量，证明了带标量输入的可控d状态模型至多需要kd个额外实数坐标，且单个秩一替换方向即可要求全部kd个。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the minimum information that must be retained for replay-free recurrent state migration, proving that a controllable d-state model with scalar input needs at most kd additional real coordinates, and that a single rank-one replacement direction can already require all of them.
